description:
Ehwa Corporation’s Oh Bitna has it all: a great career in the lingerie business, a loving fiancé, Lee Sangcheol, and a stellar reputation. However, everything comes crashing down when she finds Sangcheol is cheating on her, has stolen her promotion and even besmirched her stellar reputation! But Bitna isn’t one to go down easy. Not without getting something in return, that is. Revenge is a dish best served cold but Bitna is here to make it steaming hot and dressed in frills and laces! She joins ranks with Seo Jihun, the owner of Ehwa’s rival company, to take Ehwa down. But revenge isn’t the only thing in the works it seems… Bitna and Jihun are falling for each other. Will Bitna let her feelings for Jihun sway her or will she remain steadfast on her path for revenge?

(Source: Lezhin US)
